verdict.rationale: Tavily is an API-first product with a documented public REST API reference covering search, extract, crawl, map, research (including async status and streaming), usage, and logs endpoints. It also documents rate limits with 429/retry-after semantics, and ships official Python and JS SDKs, all reachable programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404 on all candidate paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and repos.
